description: This file defines a React component named DataTable that renders a data table with features such as sortable columns, pagination, dynamic column width calculation, and server-side or client-side data handling. It includes internal functions for measuring text width, managing sorting and pagination state, and rendering the table structure with accessibility considerations.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string using an off-screen canvas for accurate measurement, with a fallback to approximate width if canvas is unavailable.
